topic: User access and contact detail UI improvements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving user access controls, specifically for contact details. It was determined that implementing a UI enhancement in the Contact Details section is necessary to manage facility and company access permissions.

Initial discussions covered how user access is currently managed (restricting visibility based on `company_id` or allowing full view).

It was decided to prioritize work related to DOOH-133, as it is considered simpler and more immediately useful than the initial proposed feature. The required UI functionality includes a search/autocomplete mechanism for selecting multiple facilities, rather than simple checkboxes.

Later in the session, there were technical discussions regarding superadmin modes and ensuring correct deployment of user creation features.
decisions: Prioritize implementing changes related to DOOH-133 for managing contact details access.
The UI for facility/company access restriction must include a search/autocomplete multiselect feature.
action_items: Someone will review the problematic area of user access logic (DOOH-127).
Maintainer can update the storage when `facility_master_id` is available in JSON.
